no-reader:neutral-2.title: Nobody reads neutral topic
no-reader:neutral-2.message: neutral service publishes to neutral topic, but nothing consumes it: it keeps every message, unread.
no-reader:neutral-2.rationale: A topic keeps what's published until its retention ends, whether anything reads it or not. With no consumer group, nothing acts on its messages, and more partitions don't change that.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.choice: Pick what reads neutral topic, then add it and connect neutral-2 to it.
